class ConfirmView(discord.ui.View):
    """
    A simple view that shows confirmation buttons (Confirm/Cancel).

    This view is useful for confirming actions with buttons instead of reactions.

    Parameters
    ----------
    timeout: float
        The time (in seconds) to wait for a response
        defaults to 180 seconds.
    author: Optional[discord.abc.User]
        The user who can interact with the confirmation buttons.
        If None, any user can interact.
        Defaults to None.
    confirm_label: str
        The label for the confirm button.
        Defaults to "Confirm".
    cancel_label: str
        The label for the cancel button.
        Defaults to "Cancel".
    disable_after_confirm: bool
        Whether to disable all components after
        a button is pressed.
        Defaults to True.

    Examples
    --------
        Basic usage::

            from redbot.core.utils.views import ConfirmView

            view = ConfirmView()
            view.message = await ctx.send("Are you sure?", view=view)
            await view.wait()
            if view.result:
                await ctx.send("Confirmed!")
            else:
                await ctx.send("Cancelled!")

        Custom labels::

            view = ConfirmView(confirm_label="Yes", cancel_label="No")
            view.message = await ctx.send("Continue?", view=view)
            await view.wait()

        Only allow author::

            view = ConfirmView(author=ctx.author)
            view.message = await ctx.send("Delete?", view=view)
            await view.wait()
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        timeout: float = 180.0,
        author: Optional[discord.abc.User] = None,
        confirm_label: str = "Confirm",
        cancel_label: str = "Cancel",
        disable_after_confirm: bool = True,
    ):
        super().__init__(timeout=timeout)
        self.author = author
        self.result = None
        self.message = None
        self.disable_after_confirm = disable_after_confirm
        self.confirm_button = discord.ui.Button(
            style=discord.ButtonStyle.green,
            label=confirm_label,
        )
        self.confirm_button.callback = self.confirm_callback
        self.cancel_button = discord.ui.Button(
            style=discord.ButtonStyle.red,
            label=cancel_label,
        )
        self.cancel_button.callback = self.cancel_callback
        self.add_item(self.confirm_button)
        self.add_item(self.cancel_button)

    async def confirm_callback(self, interaction: discord.Interaction):
        self.result = True
        if self.disable_after_confirm:
            self.confirm_button.disabled = True
            self.cancel_button.disabled = True
            await interaction.response.edit_message(view=self)
        else:
            await interaction.response.defer()
        self.stop()

    async def cancel_callback(self, interaction: discord.Interaction):
        self.result = False
        if self.disable_after_confirm:
            self.confirm_button.disabled = True
            self.cancel_button.disabled = True
            await interaction.response.edit_message(view=self)
        else:
            await interaction.response.defer()
        self.stop()

    async def interaction_check(self, interaction: discord.Interaction) -> bool:
        if self.author is not None:
            if interaction.user.id != self.author.id:
                await interaction.response.send_message(
                    _("You are not authorized to interact with this."), ephemeral=True
                )
                return False
        return True

    async def on_timeout(self):
        if self.message is not None:
            self.confirm_button.disabled = True
            self.cancel_button.disabled = True
            await self.message.edit(view=self)
